description: Copy a file or a whole folder from this computer into the project's Files, as they are and of any type (PDFs, spreadsheets, images for slides), into the folder `to`. A folder keeps its layout; hidden files are left out. A path already in Files is skipped unless overwrite. Each file up to 64 MB. A model file becomes a model with open_in_app path instead.

path.description: Absolute path to a file or folder on this computer.

to.description: Folder in Files, e.g. "reports/". Default: the top.

name: upload_files
